tools.name: create_agent

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory (defaults to your own project)

name.description: Name for the agent (e.g., 'Backend Worker', 'Test Runner')

skills.description: List of skill names to enable for this agent

skipPermissions.description: If true (default), agent runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions flag for autonomous operation

secondaryProjectPath.description: Secondary project path to add as context (--add-dir)

allowCrossProject.description: Explicitly allow creating the agent in ANOTHER project than yours (normally rejected)

tools.name: start_agent
tools.description: Start an agent with a specific task/prompt. If agent is already running/waiting, sends the prompt as a message instead. The agent runs with its own configured permission mode.

prompt.description: The task or instruction for the agent to work on

model.description: Optional model to use. Aliases: 'sonnet', 'opus', 'haiku', 'opusplan', 'sonnet[1m]' (1M context). Full IDs: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-opus-4-6', 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'. Omit to use the agent's configured default.

tools.name: stop_agent

allowCrossProject.description: Explicitly allow acting on an agent of ANOTHER project (normally rejected)

allowCrossProject.description: Explicitly allow acting on an agent of ANOTHER project (normally rejected)

tools.name: remove_agent

allowCrossProject.description: Explicitly allow acting on an agent of ANOTHER project (normally rejected)

tools.name: ask_user

tools.name: send_slack

message.description: The message to send to Slack

tools.name: send_discord

message.description: The message to send to Discord
